name: ANGEL-CORE
source:
The eve of the Great War.
The great powers hone their fangs in secret, hiding their intent while they wait for the perfect moment. Here, at the northernmost edge of the Unified Empire, lies the frozen land of Nortland — home to a clandestine research facility of the Empire’s Silver Cross Army.
This is where the story begins.

Amid a blizzard, a train arrives in a cloud of white steam. The protagonist, a young officer newly assigned to this secret institute, steps off the train. The facility is rumored to be the linchpin of the Silver Cross Army's future victories.

Yet, to his shock, the director who greets him is a mere girl. To the stunned officer, she issues an order: to oversee and manage a group of girls referred to as "test subjects" until the day of their final disposal.

The girls cling to him, begging desperately for his embrace. Puzzled, he asks his colleagues, who answer in unison that this is just how things are here — the girls do it because they want to. Watching his comrades indulge themselves with the girls as if it were perfectly normal, the protagonist feels an unsettling discord.

Then, one day, he learns the truth: why the girls willingly offer their bodies to the soldiers, and the real reason they are labeled "test subjects". It is the Silver Cross Army's terrifying scheme — the key to victory in the coming war. He uncovers the full scope of the "Angel Core" project.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050514005705/http://www.rune.jp/products/rune/009angelcore/index.html]official site[/url]]

An Adult PC game set in the "Angel Gear" universe.
translation:
大战前夕。
各大势力暗中磨砺自己的獠牙，隐藏自己的意图，等待完美的时机。这里，在统一帝国的最北端，坐落着诺特兰的冰冻土地——帝国银十字军秘密研究设施的所在地。
这就是故事的开始。

暴风雪中，一列火车冒着白色蒸汽抵达。主角，一位新分配到这个秘密学院的年轻军官，走下火车。据传该设施是银十字军未来胜利的关键。

然而，令他震惊的是，迎接他的导演却只是一个女孩。她向目瞪口呆的警官发出命令：监督和管理一群被称为“测试对象”的女孩，直到她们被最终处置的那一天。

女孩们紧紧地抱住他，拼命地乞求他的拥抱。他很困惑地问他的同事，他们异口同声地回答说，这里的事情就是这样的——女孩们这样做是因为她们想这样做。看着同伴们若无其事地与女孩子们尽情享受，主角感到一种不安的不和谐。

然后，有一天，他得知了真相：为什么女孩们愿意将自己的身体献给士兵，以及她们被贴上“测试对象”标签的真正原因。这就是银十字军的恐怖计划——即将到来的战争胜利的关键。他揭示了“天使核心”项目的全部范围。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050514005705/http://www.rune.jp/products/rune/009angelcore/index.html]官方网站[/url]]

一款以“Angel Gear”宇宙为背景的成人电脑游戏。
